description: Sixteen polyphonic control voltage bands, each of sixteen channels, every one of the 256 values set by hand; sixteen knobs edit one band or one channel at a time.

params.text: Sets one value in the grid: with a band focused it is one channel of that band, and with a channel focused it is one band at that channel.
Sets how many channels every band output carries, 1 to 16; the controls for channels above that count are dimmed.
Multiplies the values of the focused band or channel, -2 to 2.
Adds a voltage to the values of the focused band or channel, -10V to 10V.
Sets how many of the values a randomize touches, from none at the bottom to all of them at the top.
Narrows the span a randomized value is drawn from, from a single point at the bottom to the knob's whole range at the top.
Sets how many of the values a wiggle touches, from none at the bottom to all of them at the top.
Sets how far a wiggle moves a value, from nowhere at the bottom through 2V either way at the centre to twice that at the top, and up to three times that with CV added.

inputs.text: A trigger on one channel here randomizes the channel of that number across all sixteen bands, reading high above 2V.
A trigger on one channel here randomizes the band of that number across all sixteen channels, reading high above 2V.
A trigger on any channel here randomizes every value in the grid, reading high above 2V.
A trigger on one channel here wiggles the channel of that number across all sixteen bands, reading high above 2V.
A trigger on one channel here wiggles the band of that number across all sixteen channels, reading high above 2V.
A trigger on any channel here wiggles every value in the grid, reading high above 2V.
A trigger on one channel here returns the channel of that number to its starting value across all sixteen bands, reading high above 2V.
A trigger on one channel here returns the band of that number to its starting values across all sixteen channels, reading high above 2V.
A trigger on any channel here returns every value and every scale and offset to its starting point, reading high above 2V.
Adds a tenth of its voltage to the randomize probability knob, the total held between none and all.
Adds a tenth of its voltage to the randomize range knob, the total held between a single point and the whole range.
Adds a tenth of its voltage to the wiggle probability knob, the total held between none and all.
Adds a tenth of its voltage to the wiggle range knob, the total held between nothing and three times the usual movement.
Chooses what the sixteen main knobs edit, splitting 10V either way into sixteen steps: 0V and positive voltages focus bands Alpha to Papa, negative voltages focus channels 1 to 16.

outputs.text: Carries that band's sixteen values, each scaled and offset by both its band and its channel, at as many channels as the POLY CHANNELS knob sets.

notes: an output channel's voltage is its knob value times the band scale times the channel scale, plus the band offset and the channel offset.
click a letter from A to P to focus that band, and the sixteen main knobs edit its channels 1 to 16; click a number from 1 to 16 to focus that channel, and they edit bands A to P at it.
while a cable is patched to the Focus CV jack the band letters and channel numbers stop responding, and that voltage chooses the focus instead.
RAND randomizes every value in the grid, WIG moves every value from where it is, and INIT returns every value and every scale and offset to its starting point.
the band letters, the channel numbers and the RAND, WIG and INIT buttons are plain widgets rather than knobs, so none of them can be clicked for help.
menu: Knob Range: Unipolar, Bipolar — the span of the sixteen main knobs, 0V to 10V or -10V to 10V; it starts bipolar.
